'''Cargo sleds''' were used to transport cargo on the icy planet of [[Syned]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Several were in service in the [[Arkadianate]] capital city of [[Calimondretta]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
